title: Triangle composition law for restricted fixed-coefficient single complexes
statement: Let W,S be schemes, k:W→S, F an abelian sheaf on W, A,B,C objects of Over W, f:B→A, g:C→B, a:C→A with a=g≫f, and U etale over S. Let qf,qg,qa be their canonical restricted pullback maps and hq:qa=qg≫qf. Then the explicit restricted single transition for a equals the inverse-image composition comparison for qg,qf,qa followed by qg inverse image of the transition for f and the transition for g. No indexing diagram, identity law or cone equation is asserted.

proof.text: Name the three restricted maps qf,qg,qa and second projections rA,rB,rC. The pullback projection equations give qa ≫ rA = rC ≫ a.left, qg ≫ rB = rC ≫ g.left, and qf ≫ rA = rB ≫ f.left. The hypothesis ha gives a.left = g.left ≫ f.left. Name the inverse-image comparison isomorphisms ef,eg,ea for f.left,A.hom; g.left,B.hom; and a.left,A.hom. Associativity of upperStarComp, followed by cancellation of ef and eg, gives the identity coefficient map on C as ea.hom followed by the g,f comparison, g inverse image of ef.inv, and eg.inv.

Apply the proved local square_coefficient calculation to rC, a.left, g.left, f.left, qa, qg, qf, rA, rB, and the preceding identity. Its square_triangle helper follows from three applications of upperStarComp associativity and cancellation; naturality moves the coefficient maps across the comparisons. The resulting identity is 1 = Ei.hom ≫ upperStarComp(qg,qf,qa).hom ≫ qg inverse image of the restricted coefficient for f ≫ Ej.inv. Ei and Ej are obtained from rC inverse image of ea and eg by the second-projection square comparisons. Their inverses are precisely the explicit restricted coefficients for a and g.

Cancel Ei.hom in the coefficient identity using the proved local inverse_eq_of_triangle lemma to obtain Ei.inv = upperStarComp(qg,qf,qa).hom followed by qg inverse image of the restricted coefficient for f and Ej.inv. Apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext to the desired complex identity. In degree zero, expose the explicit transition homs with restricted_single_iso_hom, proved using the defining equation restrictedOverSingleIso.eq_1 and asIso_hom. Mathlib component formulas evaluate mapHomologicalComplex, mapHomologicalComplex of the natural comparison, and the inverse-image single comparison. The proved private single_map_zero evaluates singleFunctor maps. The degree-zero evaluation isomorphisms become identities; cancel the identity morphisms. Unfold the explicit coefficient maps and Ei.inv, Ej.inv, using Iso.trans_inv and mapIso_inv. The resulting equation is exactly the cancelled coefficient identity. In every other degree, the target is a single complex with zero component, so isZero_single_obj_X.eq_of_tgt proves equality.
